name: walkers_photo_a
prompt:
Image 1 is finished art from the same 2D city game: people standing, seen from in front and high above. Match its style, finish, camera and proportions exactly — draw none of its people.
Images 2 to 4 are photos of real people, one each, in the order below. Draw each as the same person as in their photo — face, hair, build, clothes, colours, prints and anything carried — and take nothing else from the photo: not its pose, camera, light or background.

Make one image: 3 different people for the game, in one row of 3, read left to right. Each stands still, the whole body facing south — straight down the picture, towards its bottom edge — arms relaxed at the sides, feet side by side, a relaxed neutral expression, head level. The camera is in front and high above, looking down at about 55 degrees: the top of the head and the tops of the shoulders show plainly, the face is seen from above and a little shortened, the legs shorter on the picture than the body above them, the feet tucked just under the hem. Looking down shortens a body top to bottom only; it never makes it wider. Every figure has an ordinary average build — neither thin nor stocky, shoulders their natural width. The whole body is visible. Each is centred in its cell, well apart from its neighbours, never touching. All at one scale: a person 1.8 m tall fills about 70 % of the cell's height, shorter people smaller in proportion.

Style: game sprite art with a light pixel-art feel — clean simplified shapes, bold readable silhouettes, a limited palette with flat shading in two or three tones per colour, crisp hard edges. Leave small details out: no fabric texture, no stitching, no tiny patterns; faces simple, eyes, brows and mouth a few marks. Each must read clearly when shown only 60 pixels tall. Not photographic, not soft painting, not chibi: natural adult proportions. Summer in a Black Sea port city.

The people, in order:
1. 1.62 m tall. A woman of about 60 with short auburn-brown hair, in a long navy quilted coat worn open over a pale-blue jumper, a blue-and-white checked scarf, dark-grey jeans and black shoes, a dark-teal leather handbag in one hand.
2. 1.68 m tall. A woman of about 30 with long auburn hair under a black wide-brimmed hat, in a red-and-black checked flannel shirt open over a grey top, grey-green cargo trousers and dark boots.
3. 1.8 m tall. A man of about 40 with very short brown hair and a short beard, in a black T-shirt with a print on the chest — a four-square logo, red, green, blue and yellow, and the word "Microslop" in white — grey shorts, grey socks and dark-grey trainers.

Everything outside the figures is fully transparent: no background, no ground, no shadow, nothing half-transparent. No text, letters, numbers, labels, grid lines or frames anywhere, but for a print a person's clothes are said to carry.
